purpose: Exact Agent-State transition after a validated typed response has been persisted and read back.
stateRules: Copy projectId, agentId, identityRevision, session, currentJob and consumedActivationIds unchanged from the provider-confirmed RUNNING claim state.
Increment revision by exactly one from the last provider-read Agent-State revision.
Set runtimeStatus to RESULT_SUBMITTED, never SUBMITTED.
Set lastResponseRef to one canonical string reference for the provider-read-back response; it is not a pointer object.
Set updatedAt to the response submission timestamp.
Validate the complete proposed state against targetSchemaRef before persistence and validate provider readback again afterwards.
